app.title: DreamJar
app.tagline: Name your wishes, count your wins, and let every paycheck fill three jars.
app.privacy: Everything you enter stays in this browser on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
app.disclaimer: A learning tool for building money habits, not financial advice.

wishes.heading: Wishes and goals
wishes.intro: Write down up to 10 things you want. Then star the 3 that matter most: those become goals with a price, a picture and a savings bar.
wishes.placeholder: Something you want, e.g. a new bike
wishes.limit: You have 10 wishes. Delete one or star your top 3.
wishes.starLimit: You already have 3 goals. Unstar one first.
wishes.empty: Your list is empty. Start with the first wish that comes to mind.
wishes.addImage: Add a picture of this goal
wishes.countdown_one: {{count}} hour left to take a first step.
wishes.countdown_other: {{count}} hours left to take a first step.
wishes.overdue: The 72 hours are up. Take one small step today anyway.

journal.heading: Success journal
journal.intro: Every day, write down at least five things you did well, however small. Reading them back builds confidence.
journal.empty: No entries yet. What went well today?

budget.heading: Income jars
budget.intro: Each time money comes in, split it straight away: part to a jar you never spend (it grows into more money), part to your goals, and the rest to spend freely.
budget.gooseDesc: Never spent. Only invested so it keeps laying eggs.
budget.ratioError: The three parts add up to {{sum}}%. Make them add up to 100%.
budget.empty: No income recorded yet. Add the next amount you receive.

calc.heading: Compound interest
calc.intro: See how a starting sum and a small monthly amount grow when the interest earns interest too.
calc.result: After {{years}} years. You put in {{contributed}}; interest added {{interest}}.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.backupIntro: Your data lives only on this device. Export a backup file now and then, and import it to move to a new phone or browser.
settings.importConfirm: Importing replaces all current data with the backup. Continue?
settings.importError: That file is not a DreamJar backup. Choose a file exported from this app.
